text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert SEV-2 - hosted /v1/embeddings latency and errors increasing. GPU serving queue depth >95% for gpupool-primary (since 2011123448). Autoscaler retries failing.

leo_oncall: i'm on. grabbing logs + health dashboards. tagging @rina_eng @vince_ops.

rina_eng: loading traces now. sudden inbound burst ~11k reqs/s concentrated on embedding endpoint. p95 from 90ms -> 3.8s, p99 -> 15s. Frontend returned 502/504 for some requests.

vince_ops: infra shows all nodes in gpupool-primary at 100% GPU util and VRAM saturated. Autoscaler attempted to scale at 2011123452 but cloud API returned quota_error: "REGION_CPUS_LIMIT". Autoscaler then hit nodeGroup cap 'ng-embed-prod' (configured max_nodes=40).

claire_sre: checking autoscaler controller logs: we have a bug where on quota_error the controller stops further attempts and doesn't check fallback pools. Also our fallback policy was disabled accidentally in last deploy.

janet_support: customer impact? support queue shows multiple reports from customer 'vectorify-inc' and a few small customers. Opening priority notifications.

rina_eng: traces show ~70% traffic from a single API key (vectorify-prod-key). They kicked off a heavy concurrent batch embed job without chunking.

leo_oncall: immediate plan: 1) emergency per-key throttle for vectorify-prod-key 2) enable quantized model-route for large batches 3) force-enable cross-region fallback 4) notify customers. Who can do (1)?

vince_ops: i can apply throttle via gateway. setting token-bucket: 30r/s for vectorify-prod-key now.

ops-bot: rate-limit change applied (change_id: rl-5702) for key vectorify-prod-key -> 30r/s.

claire_sre: queue depth dropped from ~10.5k -> 4.8k within 75s after throttle. latency improving but still above baseline.

rina_eng: adding routing rule to map large batch requests with header `X-Batch-Size > 500` to `embed-4q` (quantized) variant. patching route: `PATCH /routing` with rule id rb-embed-fallback.

ops-bot: routing change rb-embed-fallback applied (id rb-2021).

vince_ops: attempted to spin up gpupool-burst in us-west-2 but cloud quota blocked. starting cross-region fallback to asia-south1 which has free quota; toggling smart-routing to include asia-south1.

quota-bot: Cloud quota ticket created CP-100772 and emergency quota requested. Current ETA unknown.

janet_support: messaged Vectorify account team, asked them to pause the job or reduce concurrency. Awaiting reply.

vectorify-reply (via support): "we started a one-off backfill, pausing now. sorry for the noise."

claire_sre: good. continuing mitigations: enable identical-request coalescing for embeddings (coalesce=true), enable prefix cache reuse.

ops-bot: feature toggle applied: coalesce_embedding_requests=true.

rina_eng: quick middleware patch pushed to allow autoscaler controller to attempt cross-region fallback even if primary nodeGroup at max. hotfix `hotfix/autoscaler-fallback-allow` deployed to canary.

leo_oncall: monitoring trend: p99 15s -> 6.5s -> 2.4s over 12 minutes. error rate decreased from 4.8% -> 1.1%. Backlog draining but not empty.

vince_ops: cross-region pool gpupool-burst-asia registering nodes now at 2011123492, health checks pass. Traffic gradually shifted.

janet_support: sent customer update: "We've applied temporary rate limits and routing changes; ingestion should resume gradually. We'll follow up with a post-incident report and remediation."

claire_sre: immediate root cause hypothesis: single-tenant high concurrency batch job + autoscaler nodeGroup cap + fallback-disabled bug = sustained GPU saturation -> queue growth -> p95/p99 spike and 5xxs.

leo_oncall: handoff: i'll stay 10m then hand to claire. create incident channel #inc-2011123456 for follow-ups. Postmortem owners: rina_eng (runtime/controller bug), vince_ops (quota & infra), janet_support (customer comms).

rina_eng: checklist: save traces, exporter logs, autoscaler controller logs, gateway rate-limit event ids, routing patch id, toggle states. Will draft postmortem in 48h.

quota-bot: Cloud provider responded to CP-100772: emergency quota approved for asia-south1 + us-west-2 (increase CPU quota + GPU quota).

claire_sre: adding runbook change: warn if queue_depth>4k for 5m -> auto-enable cross-region fallback and surface quota escalation link to oncall.

leo_oncall: severity reduced to SEV-3 at 2011123499. status: mitigated -> degraded. leaving notes, handing off to claire. excellent coordination.

janet_support: i'll follow up with Vectorify for RCA input and ask about throttling recommendations.
